not_added_flag.item: Dos Amigos Churchill vitola (Mac filename: DosAmigos_Churchill_01.jpg)
not_added_flag.issue: No source found documents a Churchill vitola for the Dos Amigos 1987 line. Every source consistently describes the brand's catalog as exactly 2 vitolas (Robusto 'Paster' and Toro 'Sidecar'), explicitly contrasted against having 'a large catalogue.' Since this is a brand-new line (launched late 2025, still rolling out through 2026 trade shows), a Churchill could theoretically be an unannounced/later addition, but there is zero evidence for one. Possible explanations, none confirmed: (1) an unannounced future SKU; (2) the photo shows a different, unrelated 'Dos Amigos' cigar from a different small/boutique maker; (3) a filing error. NOT published as a confirmed vitola.
